title: Timeout, Then Triumph
description: A gateway timeout looks different from a hard decline to the customer, but both must leave the door open for a retry. Walk an invoice through timeout, decline, and eventual success, and confirm the full three-attempt history is preserved exactly.
successCondition: Create an invoice. Attempt 1 with cardNumber 4000000000000119 returns payment.status "timed_out", failureReason containing "gateway_timeout", attemptNumber 1, invoice still open. Attempt 2 with cardNumber 4000000000000002 returns payment.status "declined", failureReason containing "card_declined", attemptNumber 2, invoice still open. Attempt 3 with a non-decline/timeout card returns payment.status "succeeded", attemptNumber 3, invoice now "paid". GET /api/billing/invoices/:id/payments returns exactly these 3 payments in order 1, 2, 3 with matching statuses, and a 4th pay attempt now returns 409 CONFLICT.
hints: The two special-cased decline/timeout card numbers and their exact failureReason substrings are documented in the mock gateway table in docs/api/billing.md.
Run the three attempts strictly sequentially — attemptNumber is derived from a live count of existing Payment rows at the moment each call runs.
